title: After the Tenno Sho (Autumn): Muddy Runaway Festival ★

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer and Daitaku Helios fight for the lead on the long final stretch of the autumn Tenno Sho, and the crowd is beyond thrilled.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen will be the final hurrah for the two besties. Mejiro Palmer is determined to show everyone what she's found by running away from the Mejiro family.
